scope: Published original baseline (60 trials), H0-H4 original screens (100 trials) and identical-prompt follow-ups (200 trials). Failed attempts and earlier pilot screens are excluded.
method: Tool results before final submission are matched to their recorded tool call ID, and compared with the frozen inputs. Initial user prompts are checked directly. Evidence message positions are one-based in the observable transcript.
interpretation: For H0-H4, sections refer to the edits relative to baseline. For baseline, they refer to the four supplied files, and a complete file return is required. The audit records exposure and does not measure attention or whether an edit was used.
